definitions.explanation: A traditional term for a female nurse. Note: This term is now considered dated; the gender-neutral term {看護師|かんごし} is now the standard professional title.

examples.japanese: {看護婦|かんごふ}さんが{注射|ちゅうしゃ}をしてくれた。
examples.english: The nurse gave me an injection.

examples.japanese: {姉|あね}は{病院|びょういん}で{看護婦|かんごふ}として{働|はたら}いています。
examples.english: My older sister works as a nurse at a hospital.

notes: This term specifically refers to female nurses. Modern Japanese prefers the gender-neutral {看護師|かんごし} (kangoshi), which is now the official professional term used in healthcare settings. You may still encounter {看護婦|かんごふ} in older texts or informal speech.
